# Thai Hoa Gloves

> > Leading Vietnamese manufacturer of nitrile gloves for cleanroom, healthcare, electronics, and food processing industries with ISO, GMP, and ESD compliance.

Thai Hoa Gloves specializes in powder-free nitrile gloves and cleanroom protective equipment for high-precision industries including semiconductor manufacturing, pharmaceutical production, and medical applications. The company provides comprehensive technical guidance on cleanroom standards (ISO 5-8, Class 10-100,000), ESD protection, and contamination control.

## Key Topics

- Nitrile gloves (gang-tay-nitrile)
- Cleanroom standards (ISO 5, ISO 6, Class 10, Class 100, Class 1000)
- ESD protection (chong-tinh-dien)
- GMP compliance
- Powder-free gloves
- Electronics manufacturing (PCB, IC assembly)
- Healthcare & medical applications (y-te)
- Food processing safety (che-bien-thuc-pham)
- Contamination control
- Latex-free alternatives
- Chemical resistance (khang-hoa-chat)
- Cleanroom apparel
- ASTM D6319 & EN 455 standards
- Microbial control
- Environmental protection (bao-ve-moi-truong)
